- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Modernisme Art Nouveau Style is a distinct architectural feature of Barcelona, popular in the late 19th and early 20th century.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Antoni Gaudi's organic style features undulating shapes, colorful ceramic tiles, mosaics, and intricate sculptural details.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Barcelona has impressive Gothic architecture, including the Cathedral of Barcelona and other churches, monasteries, and civic buildings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cast-iron balconies are a significant feature in Barcelona, often painted white and intricately designed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Public parks in Barcelona are designed as artistic works for public enjoyment, featuring fountains and sculptures.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Transformative architecture in Barcelona allows buildings to switch functions (homes, offices, shops, hotels, galleries) in weeks or months.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Collage architecture in Barcelona mixes new and old styles, balancing contemporary styles with historical heritage.
- [PREFERENCE] User loves the cast-iron balconies in Barcelona.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for seeing the best cast-iron balconies include:
  - Eixample district, particularly Passeig de Gràcia.
  - Barri Gotic (Gothic Quarter).
  - El Raval, especially Carrer de Joaquin Costa and Carrer dels Tallers.
  - Born district, particularly Passeig del Born.
  - Ciutat Vella (Old City).
